reviews.review_description: Go Solar Newcastle installed our solar system a few years ago. I left a review at the time. We were very happy with the product and the company at that time. We recently had 2 x 5kWh Enphase batteries, and the IQ System Controller 3 INT, with blackout protection, installed by Kallan and his team from GoSolar Newcastle. We are equally impressed with the company this time, more so.Since the battery install, we have had a (planned) full day blackout, a long weekend with the house full of visiting family, and a period of visitors staying in our granny flat. The system has been fantastic. It is performing exactly as Kallan had calculated, and has not missed a beat. The app that comes with the Enphase system is easy and comprehensive.I don't usually leave reviews, but this is the 2nd time that GoSolar Newcastle have delivered so well for us. Apart from the home visit, quote process, and install (which were all seamless), Kallam also fixed a problem on our roof that had nothing to do with the solar, at no cost and with no fuss.Great company, with great people, and great products and services. We couldn't be happier.
Friendly & capable install team which inspired confidence, installed only 2 weeks after accepting quote, no issues (though has been in for only a few weeks), enphase app quite schmick
From start to finish the people at go solar newcastle were great. Up front and honest.

I recently made the decision to switch to solar energy and after thorough research, I opted for GoSolar Newcastle's 6.6kW micro inverter system. From the initial consultation to the final installation, my experience with GoSolar Newcastle has been exceptional.First and foremost, the product itself is top-notch. The 6.6kW micro inverter system is highly efficient and has already started producing savings on my energy bills. The panels are durable and sleek, seamlessly integrating with my roof without compromising aesthetics.The installation process was smooth and hassle-free. The team from GoSolar Newcastle arrived promptly and worked diligently to set up the system. Their expertise was evident as they navigated any potential challenges with ease, ensuring that the installation was completed to the highest standard.What truly sets GoSolar Newcastle apart is their outstanding service. From the moment I reached out for a quote to post-installation support, their team has been nothing short of professional and accommodating. They patiently answered all my questions and provided valuable insights to help me make informed decisions.Moreover, their commitment to customer satisfaction is commendable. They took the time to understand my specific energy needs and tailored the system accordingly, ensuring optimal performance and maximum savings.One standout aspect was their willingness to go the extra mile. While other solar companies submitted quotes via email only, GoSolar Newcastle took the time to visit my house, working through the product and proposed design in person. This personal touch and attention to detail truly made a difference in my decision-making process.Overall, I couldn't be more pleased with my decision to choose GoSolar Newcastle for my solar needs. Their exceptional product quality, seamless installation process, and unparalleled customer service have exceeded my expectations. I wholeheartedly recommend GoSolar Newcastle to anyone considering solar energy solutions. With them, you can rest assured that you're investing in a reliable and efficient solar system backed by a team of professionals dedicated to your satisfaction.

Interactions with sales and installation staff were professional and courteous, there were very minor hiccups with installation process that was discussed and sorted out to my satisfaction.Would definitely recommend the team at gosolar

From the quote, through to the completion the process was great. I got 3 quotes and was very pleased with GoSolar Newcastle’s approach and price. Lewis explained everything and was very patient with our large number of questions and the fact we took a bit of time to decide. He did not pressure me to sign on the day (as another company tried).The installers were great. We had an old system removed and not a bit of rubbish was left.

Very happy with our Solar Installation from Go Solar Newcastle. Lewis was really great to deal with from the very start and more than happy to answer any questions we were unsure of. The Installers did a great job and we had no issues. Grid connection was no drama at all, they talked us through exactly how the process goes and getting our smart meter fitted. Highly recommend.

Go Solar were very quick to contact and discuss our solar needs and receptive to our questions.Followed up followed up with appointment and came out to inspect our house and provided information and discussed solar needs.Clear information provided about quote.Receptive to all questions, very polite and good communication.Punctual and timely responses to all emails.Installers were on time, polite and responsive to our questions and ran us through how the system worked.Couldn't ask for a better team of professional.

Sales and quoting was informative. Answered all my questions honestly plus referred me to further independent readingInstall was seamless, with incredibly courteous and professional electrician and installers who knew their stuff and explained all processes clearly.
Great experience from first contact, to design, to to installation. Went as per advertised. Installers were particularly impressive. Very happy so far.
Prompt service tidy and neat installation helped with the connection

I was very satisfied with my experience in dealing with Go Solar Newcastle. The process for receiving a quote, responding to subsequent questions, and installation all went very smoothly. There was good communication to inform me about unavoidable delays due to weather, and there were no problems at all with the work to complete the installation. I am very happy with the quality of the supplied system with Hyundai panels and Enphase microinverters. The only thing I would say is that the sales rep wasn't fully aware of limitations that AGL place on system size to qualify for their residential solar savers plan in order to receive the maximum 17c per kWhr feed-in tariff.

Actually installing systems on two adjacent houses and used two different installers. Looking mainly for reliability on this installation and chose Enphase/Hyundai 3.9kW system. On site inspection and quotes good and follow up questions answered promptly. Installation fast but perhaps not as safety conscious as the other installer. Cleaned up and work tidily done. Problem with tripping power supply to house followed up and promptly rectified.Salesman said they would do the complete installation including engaging level 2 electrician to install isolation fuse in switchboard, but this was not done. Neither was the energy provider given any details of the installation. Result system is still not operational whilst I arrange both these issues. Very disappointing result and not what was (verbally) promised. Should have got this in writing! System testing seems to show good operational results, but subsequent quote from the installer of the other system (after I had accepted this one) shows I could have had this system installation done at a significantly lower cost.
Helpful all throughout the process. Turned up on time when they said they would. Neat and tidy installation. Would not hesitate to recommend.

Very happy thus far. System performing as expected. Install was with minimal disruption and looks great. The team even replaced unknown broken tiles from other parts of roof with spares I had when spotted during install.

The initial experience with Go Solar Newcastle was impacted by COVID-19 lockdown. Hence, consultation was via other means than direct face to face contact. This was a difficult hurdle for me as my preference was and is a more personal contact. However, despite the difficulties Go Solar were able to help me overcome my concerns and were patient in providing the information I required in making my decision on the components, size and configuration. They were also able to build my confidence in their ability to provide to provide and install a PV system to my satisfaction. Particularly, important was their patience and flexibility in providing quotes. Installation was 'seamless.' The Go Solar team arrived promptly at the designated time, were polite, explained the process, answered questions and freely provided explanations. They were efficient and quick. After they left there was no evidence that they had been, except for the new panels on the roof. Allow the 'paperwork' for organising the grid connection was provided promptly. Overall a very good experience.

Had two quotes presented. Both were professional and helpful, and provided similar prices for similar configurations (Enphase/LG).  However could only accept one and went for the system with the slightly higher spec panels.The installation went without hitch and was completed in 3-4 hours.  Could not be happier with the install team and the end product.The energy provider installed the smart switch two and a half weeks after solar panels were installed. The system has been working well since then without incident.

1.  The sales/quoting process was very efficient.  Salesperson on time, quotation arrived by email that evening.2.  Installation was booked in within about 3 weeks.  Installers arrived at 7.30am and all was finished by about 1pm same day.  They were very tidy.3.  Customer service was good - good explanation of the system, app etc.  Grid connection fine.  We are now just waiting for our electricity supplier to connect us.
Face to face sales & quote which I preferred.The installation great turned up on the day at the time organised light shower of rain caused a slight holdup.Customer service 10 out 10.

I was provided with several configurations to choose from and they were accommodating and flexible to my requests.The quoting, installation and were painless and they were good to deal with.They had the sharpest pricing for a premium system (approx $1,500 cheaper than next quote for same system).

GoSolar was the only installer who visited ourproperty to inspect. We were looking for quality and longevity. He listened and answered all our questions promptly. During COVID19 the company kept us informed of happenings and set an installation date which they kept to. They maintained social distancing ( important as we have a 92 year old father living with us. They were polite and prompt. We are enjoying reading the power performance according to enphase and organising power usage accordingly. We are waiting on grid connection at present.

Excellent customer service. Very responsive. Onsite consultation a service not offered but many solar companies . Great products .quality system.Booked installation day, installed large system in half a day. Very smooth process. Excellent experience alround.
Process from qoutation to installation was smooth and efficient  - excellent team work!
Very happy with the experience and the team at Go Solar Newcastle. Only issue now is waiting for Energy Australia to change the meter, now four weeks.
All went extremely smoothly.The installation was uneventful with a likeable and professional team. They also organised the grid connection.Thank you for making the whole process so easy.Bob
Time taken for retailer to install new meter is dragging on. Promised next week 1 month after system installed. All those sunny days lost.
We were very pleased with the whole process, from sales to installers. We would highly recommend GoSolar to any prospective buyer.
Some Solar companies would not come out to quote, only quoting online.Go Solar were very professional and came out to my home and made it a personal decision.

We would of liked to know that our electricity provider had to install the meter box instead of Go Solar. They have been quite slow and uninformative, as soon as they found out we had Solar power they put the price up. Could you please give any suggestions what to do? Regards Geoff

My solar array has now been installed for 2 months and Energy Australia seem unable to install a net meter as they only sent a level 1 asp who was unable to complete job. Further discussion revealed that EA donâ€™t have any level 2 aspâ€™s in my city ( Newcastle , 6th largest city in Australia ). I am currently engaging an independent level 2 asp to do work but requires me to start at the beginning. Donâ€™t expect any resolution for another month or so. Shouldnâ€™t be this difficult.
You get what you pay for.

The installation happened very fast. Felt quite overwhelmed with the amount of written information - hard to figure out what was required and what was 'extras'. Communication was difficult by phone, and all done via email - I really wanted to speak with someone and ask a a series of questions, but this didn't seem to be a possibility.The system is in place but not yet working as the energy company has sent unqualified technicians out to finalise - I understand this is not the issue of the installer. But at this stage I am not able to comment on the quality of the system as it is not yet functional.

Origin Energy notified prior installation, again afterwards, unable to locate documents which then resubmitted.Now have to wait their attendance 'within 30 working days' from receiving documents to activate the system.Process hard to understand causing seemingly unnecessary delays.So the system remains inactive at this stage.

Everything went well until the installation was "complete". The provision of quotes, the prices, sales follow-up, competitive package, component quality, installer performance, and response times to emails were all excellent. The disappointing issues relate to communication and failure to know what to do to arrange net metering.I cannot understand how a major Newcastle-based solar installer in April 2018 can fail to know what is necessary to arrange net metering in NSW after the changes introduced on 1 December 2017. I was told by the installer (the boss in the office, not the electricians on site) that his practice was to send a completion report to AusGrid and they took care of metering and that he did not deal with retail providers. However, the requirement is that installers advise the retail provider (with a very specific form for Origin, as I discovered) who then arranges a level 2 Authorised Service Provider to attend to the metering. This became a messy business, causing stress and resulting in delays (metering still has not been done). For all I know, every other customer with installation performed by this company since the policy change may still be waiting for metering!
Go Solar are a very professional company and did everything they said they would, when they said they would. Highly recommended.
See what made me choose them section.
we haven't had it installed yet Happy to review once installed

24   Pv 330w AC Enphase/LG Neon 2Enphase S270 MicroinvertersPV EnvoyS Comms/Control/Consumption & Production Monitoring Unit1  Enphase AC Battery  1.2 KWhAlready had a 30 tube Evacuated Solor hot water system fitted

After 3 weeks since installation we are still waiting for a solar meter. I called AGL on the day of installation and have had to chase up 5 times before being asked to contact another company called Activestream who have given me an ETA of the 5th June. GoSolar Newcastle has told me not to turn in the solar and battery system until the meter change has been done, with the beautiful sunny days we have been having it is a little frustrating having such an expensive investment on our roof that we canâ€™t turn on.
Very happy with the system so far. Obtained half a dozen quotes and GoSolar Newcastle were one of the few that bothered to come out to discuss the system.
I wasn't interested in going with a company outside of Newcastle because I think they would give better after sales service and I believe in keeping things local as far as I can.

Good advice from Sales Person. Installing subcontractor here on time with people who knew their work. Monitoring system with enphase excellent. Warranty statements given on Panels & Enphase but not particularly from GoSolar but follow up from GoSolar re monitoring was very good. Happy with overall performance and would use them again for expansion of system and battery installation. Please use my Christian name only on your website.

I asked for 7 quotes (6 responses) from various suppliers but only one made a site visit to discuss the options open to me. All of the others used Google Earth to demonstrate panel positioning on the roof some of which would not physically fit! A couple only offered a site visit after I had paid the deposit. Some of the quotes were very light on information being just a page with 4 lines, panel price, inverter price and installation cost then the total- not much to work with there! A face to face meeting every time for me. Very important to be able to ask direct questions and get an immediate answer and clarification, if required, to make a decision on a substantial financial investment. I have no hesitation in recommending Gosolar Newcastle to install and monitor a solar power system.

The quote was comparable with others but included a battery for free. The system was very quickly installed and a few teathing problems with electronics were quickly dealt with. There was a delay in replacing the electricity meter so we could start to get credit for our surplusses. This was due to an issue with the network operator. GoSolar were always prompt and couteous and efficient to deal with. I have all supporting warrantees, contracts, instructions, and a fantastic mobile app to manage the system. The whole experience was better than my expectations.
This company was the only one who came and consulted as to what unit would be best for our needs and followed up on installation
Thanks Finn for helping make the whole process much easier.Of the 3 quotes we were very happy with our choice and so far the very efficient service.  (system installed this week).
Excellent service from all involved
The enlighten computer system does not appear to be working OK.....still says using power from grid despite having half full batteries

Excellent advice from Wayne the Sales Person. Installing subcontractor here on time with people who knew their work. Monitoring system with enphase excellent. Warranty statements given on Panels & Enphase but follow up from GoSolar re monitoring was very excellent. Phoned us when someone turned the switch off in our electrical box whilst house was still being built. Will be adding batteries at a later date after we move in as GoSolar will be monitoring and then advise us how to best use the system. Have recommended their system to 4 people who will be building in our neighborhood.

Sales person technically competent and electrical staff and contractors worked together to achieve optimal quality installation.Workmanship excellent and all waste removed from site. Overall a pleasant experience  and after sales and installation service first rate.All queries responded to within the hour and resolved ASAP. Not the cheapest per kWh price,but technically advanced top quality products and service to match. So pleased I went with GoSolar Newcastle. Having said that, I believe the other two quotations were competitive and offered good value for money.Thank you Fenn for pointing me in the right direction on specifications and obtaining quotations from quality suppliers,that took a lot of stress out of the exercise.All completed within three weeks from contacting you and completion and metering of output.

They were a bit slow to contact and come out to talk and do a quote, BUT, the system was installed a few days after that. The sales person took Photo's of the switchbox, but when they came out and started to wire it up, we were told that the switchbox would have to be rewired, because it had the old type fuses in it, and the energy inspector would not pass it like it was.  This cost a further $1400. I agreed to this, so we are up to date with the new safety rules. BUT, i think this should have been picked up when the sales person did the quote and looked at the switchbox. Other than this , a great transaction.

The system was installed on 15/06/2015 and was operational the same day. I can highly recommend GoSolar Newcastle, they delivered what they promised; a high quality solar system at a reasonable price and on the agreed schedule.
They were not the best price but  no hidden costs or Adonis or extras a job well done .
Wayne's technical knowledge and focus to match me up with a system to suit my needs plus the ongoing lifetime support to help me get the optimum usage from my system.

Gosolar contacted me the same day I requested quotes from your site. I was not sure about going solar. After talking to the sales person and beiing shown the product they had I could see the benefits of solar. I ended up installing a 3.4kW panel and battery system and it has been great virtually off the grid. I am very glad I found your site it made things so much easier for me. Through no fault of yours , the only thing I was disappointed in was the other two companies never contacted me for several days, a phone call doesn't take much. GoSolar's quick contact made all the difference.

Very knowledgeable and only suggested the system most optimal for our situation. Comprehensive run through of why this system. All questions answered and follow up of any queries were prompt. Installation process was quick and efficient. The system is operating well and the enlighten analysis tool for our system will enable decisions to be made on storage at a future date.
Won't try to sell you a system you don't require. Know their stuff and honest to boot Highly recommended

This company supplied a quote for the system that we had requested rather than their cheapest system.Their representative explained the system and how it worked with clear and concise information and demonstrated results of other systems in our local area.They also monitor the system and calculate / advise battery storage requirements for our particular needs.
No hype, no hard sell, advised me to proceed incrementally re batteries. Seemed to be on my side! So far, so good
Installation took one day and charges were $1847 a good days pay for one person.
Only negative was the installer was smoking during the entire installation and we have a small baby.

Go Solar were very efficient. We had the whole microinverter sytem installed and up and running within 2 weeks. The installation team were very good. Very courteous , considerate and efficient. I have had a few questions about the internet feed which have been followed up and answered very quickly. Overall, we are very happy with everything and almost looking forward to our next bill.

The three quotes were three different experinces. One was just an email with very little info. Another, was alright but he was scatty and seemed desperate thus putting pressure on for a sale. Go Solar was the most professional, knowledgable and no pressure sale.
From the first contact Go Solar were very professional and did everything they said they would.Definitely recommend them to anybody looking for solar.

Anyone in the Hunter region thinking of going solar, should contact GoSolar Newcastle. They are up to speed with the latest in Solar technology and have been established in the Hunter region for decades. I without hesitation,  recommend GoSolar Newcastle as a main contender for your Solar power needs.

Early days on the installation ,seems to be going well. A lot of the issues are in regards technology and to be expected, but easily sorted out. A misunderstanding by the installer on location on the roof, but also an easy sort out once I called Go solar. Overall a good experience by a local company, that really trades on it's reputation.
It's not always about the price, most suppliers think that everyone wants the cheapest, sometimes they forget that some people do their homework & investigate there product & services.
Sales team was good with no pressure to buy, installation was completed in one day, professional, cleaned up afterwards, and after sales contact was good.
Very professional, panel installation and electrical hook up.All staff very friendly and supportive highly recommended.
Overall, the experience was quite good. No hassles. The solar panels were installed on the day nominated and was connected to the grid the following day.

The installation was good but there was no contact with these people. they kept saying someone would contact us for every part of the transaction but no one ever did. We were told we would get a call within 24 hours of accepting the quote. I Waited 4 days then rang.  Was told they would be here on the following Thursday. they did come and install the system, saying the electrician would ring to arrange a time to finish the connection. He didn't,t ring but just turned up a few days later. t was lucky we were home. The installers had only connected half the panels and the electrician could only do half of his job. He phoned the installers who said they would phone us to say when they would be coming back.  Waited over a week then started making calls to the office. Twice I was told someone would contact me but another week went by then someone finally rang to say they were coming.Finally, the job was complete but if someone had told us what was going on it would have made it a lot easier on us. I paid the account by direct credit to their bank account then waited for confirmation that it had been received. after a few days I sent an email asking for confirmation the payment had been received and received a reply saying yes the payment had been received. Not even a thank you from them. The system seems to be working great so that's the main thing.

These guys seemed to be excellent with their information up front and there were no surprises or delays with installation.They were much more positive with the product compared to the other quotes that we received.All contact with office and installers was well above average.
The service provider returned post installation to walk us through all the statistics so we had the ability to understand the information being provided by the unit to better appreciate the solution.

Go Solar offered 5 kW on each of 2 phases. The others wanted to load up all 5 kW on 1 phase so better utilization of power generated.They also did not think I would get my money's worth out of solar HW, the others did not tell me that.Very happy with the deal, the install and the after sales service and advice I received .......Go Solar!!!

Unlike the first Quote who followed the encyclopedia sales pitch wasting an afternoon of our time for a huge price tag and wondered why we did not grab the offer. "Go Solar" ex Solahart Lake Macquarie quoted over the phone and internet, they have almost completed the work bar the exchange of the Energy Aust power meter this Thursday. There price was not the cheapest but not by much, but the offer was the products that I believe to be the best. Lyn has met the cell installers and Justin their electrician, but I have yet to meet Wayne or any of the team. Maybe on a rainy day when the Government rebate rush is over. I would have liked to deal face to face but we were both busy. Where I work I buy lots of goods internationally and locally and you get a feel for the quallity of people you deal with. I guess that is why I trusted them and when I get my first power bill after they are running I will get a better sense of the quality of goods I have paid for.

GoSolar Newcastle was one of your three choices recommended. They were very efficient, courteous, and on time with their work. Lindsay went out of his way to answer our queries quickly and gave us all the additional information we needed to make an informed decision. The panel installation looks great on the roof.

The company name is actually gosolarnewcastle.com.au but are obviously with Solahart. We liked the simplicity that Wayne Harrower the sales manager presented to us and the efficiency in dealing with any queries at the time and phone calls made later.Ecosmart were also very good but not as clear with their presentation or information about the different types of panels available.The third company, Mark Group Australia followed up with an email after the first contact. However, we did not hear anymore from them I would not hesitate to recommend the company we used and with a better presentation and explanation we did not really have a problem with Ecosmart either.
The installation was efficient and very professional. We would be happy to recommend Solahart to anyone considering solar power.
Good advice, excellent service and knowledgeable people. I would recommend them to anyone.
We thought Gosolar came to us through Solar Quotes.

As I live away, a lot of the liason was done through my twenty year old son.  This was the only company that knew how to make and keep appointments, return calls and seemed interested in the job. They gave my son what I needed and he had no problems with them. The installation and end result was good and I have no complaints with this company at all.  I would recommend everyone at least get a quote from them as my experience with them was good.

We had no idea about Solar. We read all that Finn sent us and then got 3 quotes. The decision we made was an informed decision on the advise we were given.We are very happy with our end product and the service we got from Solarhart Lake Macquarie.
